name: menubar
useFor: Use at the top of a dense tool (a statement viewer, an editor) where menus group many commands. Keep three to six menus, each a MenubarMenu with a trigger and its content.
constraints: A menubar for site navigation (use navigation menu)
A blue key for the open menu
Nested menus deeper than one level
